commands.neoessentials.tablist.help:
§6§lTablist Commands (BungeeTabListPlus-style):
§e/tablist reload §7— reload tablist.json + animations.json
§e/tablist enable/disable §7— toggle tablist system
§e/tablist preview §7— preview your header/footer
§e/tablist info §7— full status, proxy, layout, fake players
§e/tablist set header/footer <text> §7— runtime override
§6Per-player:
§e/tablist player <name> header/footer/reset
§e/tablist player <name> nametag prefix/suffix <text> §7— above-head nametag override
§6Per-group:
§e/tablist group <group> header/footer/reset
§e/tablist group <group> nametag prefix/suffix <text> §7— above-head nametag override
§7Nametag defaults to the same prefix/suffix chat uses; config: tablist.json → nametagSettings
§6Proxy (BTLP-style):
§e/tablist proxy status §7— proxy integration status
§e/tablist proxy setserver <name> <count> §7— manual count
§6Fake Players (BTLP-style):
§e/tablist fakeplayer list §7— show configured fake entries
§e/tablist fakeplayer add <id> <display> §7— add runtime entry
§e/tablist fakeplayer remove <id> §7— remove entry
§e/tablist fakeplayer refresh §7— re-inject all fake entries
§6Layout (BTLP-style):
§e/tablist layout info §7— show column/sorting config
§6Independent mode:
§e/tablist independent §7— show mode
§e/tablist independent on/off §7— toggle
§6Animations:
§e/tablist animations list §7— list loaded animations
§7Use §e{animation:NAME}§7 in headers, footers, MOTD, etc.
§7Config: §fconfig/neoessentials/tablist.json
§7Animations: §fconfig/neoessentials/animations.json
§7Placeholders: §f{network_online} {server_online:NAME} {current_server}
§7             {rank_weight} {session_minutes} {level} {health} {afk}
§7             §e{animation:NAME}
